mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id as placeId, p.content_id as contentId, p.name as name, p.address as address, p.latitude as latitude, p.longitude as longitude, p.description as description, ct.content_type_id as contentTypeId, ct.name as contentTypeName FROM Place p join ContentType ct on p.content_type_id = ct.content_type_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT img_id as imgId, url FROM PlaceImg WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY img_id ASC
